notes.title: Pause, stones and plants
notes.content:
Major Changes

- Added Pause
- Better Controller Support

Gameplay changes

- Stones, crates and movable object reworked so the player cannot get stuck
- Added a new kind of scrolling ladder
- Map tweaks and routes

Graphical changes

- Added new sprites to the tilemap
- new plants added

Bugfixes

- Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash if the player died while the Jelly was shooting
- Cleaned the instances for better performance
